motionAllow.name: ds-shell-sidebar
motionAllow.reason: The design-system app shell animates its sidebar column when it collapses (css/layout.css .ds-shell). The shell owns it. Ford allowed it for knowledge-system, and this config reuses that allowance for the same shell.

pages.note: The prompt list: the catalog's prompts in the sidebar, one section per project, and the Choose a prompt note in the main lane. Start the studio with bun run dev in codecaine/core/prompt-kit/packages/studio (vite on 127.0.0.1:4860). (registry route prompts)

One prompt open in the Lab: Prompt Editor, the first prompt in the prompt-kit catalog. The Lab reads its requests from the Prompt service, which must have the /api/annotations routes, or the page shows only the 404 message. Nothing is clicked or typed. (registry route prompt)
